name: Tab buttons
explanation: Select Saved presentation, Data, Run, Results, Window, History or Help. Changing tabs does not start an orbit computation.

name: Quick search
explanation: Type a help question and press Enter. Opens Help and searches the local documentation. It does not change run settings.

name: Job indicator
explanation: Shows active job stage and fractional completion when a new run is executing.
condition: An active job has emitted progress

name: Guide
explanation: Opens the separate interactive feature guide in a new browser tab. Its older walkthrough images/text can differ from the current app; this manual uses current controls.

name: Theme (◐)
explanation: Switch between light and dark themes. Saved in browser local storage; does not change scientific results.

name: Quit (⏻)
explanation: Stops the local Java server and cancels active jobs. Confirm to stop, cancel to keep presenting. The browser page then reports shutdown.

name: Experiment
explanation: Select a stored campaign profile; filters the archived table without running anything.

name: Product tier
explanation: Restrict the selected archived profile by GPS product tier. A filter with no cases gives an empty-state message.

name: Download all OEMs
explanation: Downloads the complete archived OEM ZIP, including all experiment profiles and accompanying interpretation notes.

name: Output explanation PDF
explanation: Downloads the report explaining the OEM fields, units, coverage and limitations.

name: Complete coverage CSV
explanation: Downloads all 427 attempted cases, including unissued results.

name: View
explanation: Opens saved details for the selected case. The first matching case is selected automatically after filtering.

name: Download this OEM
explanation: Downloads exactly the selected archived ephemeris. It does not recompute or select a better result.
condition: Selected case has an issued OEM

name: Saved inputs, fit and environment metadata
explanation: Expand to inspect input basenames, saved fit settings, environment assumptions and the source CSV SHA-256. These are provenance records, not editable live settings.

name: Archived summary and state table
explanation: Attempt/issued/rejected counts, status, day-one/day-seven scored errors, interval and eight UTC state samples. Display values are rounded; the OEM retains stored precision. Not scored is not zero error. Daily samples must not be interpolated into a dense orbit track.

name: + Add files / folders
explanation: Choose existing files or directories on the machine running the Java server. Directories are expanded and recognized files are catalogued by content. Does not move or delete the originals.

name: Watch folder
explanation: Register a directory for automatic discovery of new or changed files. This is input indexing, not orbit processing.

name: Rescan
explanation: Re-read known files and update changed metadata/checksums. Does not run OD or propagation.

name: Create demo dataset
explanation: Writes SIMULATED observations, navigation, precise products and a reference orbit to the selected directory. This does computation and writes files. The demo is not real Sentinel-3A data.

name: Watched-folder ×
explanation: Stop watching that folder; does not delete files.

name: Kind filter
explanation: Filter catalog rows by recognized type; Coverage canvas and total count still describe the catalog.

name: Filter by name
explanation: Case-insensitive substring filter on file names. Combines with Kind filter; does not search file contents.

name: Catalog row hover
explanation: Hover Name to see the full path and SHA-256. Columns are Kind, Name, Sat, Class, UTC coverage, Size, Note and Forget.

name: Forget ×
explanation: Remove that catalog entry only. The original file is not deleted; watching/rescanning may rediscover it.

name: Coverage canvas
explanation: Colored intervals group files by recognized kind and show their validity dates. It shows availability, not forecast accuracy or issue-time eligibility.

name: Root / Home
explanation: Navigate the filesystem roots returned by the local server or its Home directory. Options vary by OS: Windows drives or Linux root, plus Home.

name: Path
explanation: Type a directory path on the server machine; press Enter or Go to navigate. Browser download paths and server filesystem paths are distinct.

name: Go
explanation: Navigate to the typed Path.

name: Parent (⬑ ..) and folder names
explanation: Click a parent/folder name to navigate inside it; this does not itself select the directory.

name: Selection checkbox / radio
explanation: Multi mode allows any files/folders and multiple selections. Single-file mode allows one file; folder mode allows one folder. Selection can be preserved across navigation in multi mode.

name: Select
explanation: Return the checked/radio-selected path(s) to the calling input or catalog action. An empty selection returns no paths.

name: Use this folder
explanation: Choose the directory currently being browsed, even if its radio item is not checked.

name: Cancel / Escape / background click
explanation: Dismiss without applying a selection. Shared custom dialogs support Escape and clicking the backdrop.

name: Workflow
explanation: OD + Forecast fits pre-cutoff GNSS position fixes and predicts forward. Propagate from a state starts from a typed/file state and skips GNSS orbit fitting.

name: Presets
explanation: Lists saved user preset names plus the empty placeholder. Presets depend on the current workspace and are not fixed model options.

name: Load
explanation: Load the selected preset settings into the form. Does not run it.

name: Save as…
explanation: Save the current configuration under the entered preset name. Cancel or an empty name does nothing.

name: Delete preset
explanation: Delete only the selected saved preset after confirmation. Does not delete a previous run or raw input.

name: Export
explanation: Download current settings as JSON using the run name or ursc-config. This is a configuration, not an OEM.

name: Import
explanation: Choose a local .json settings file; parse it and load it into the form. Invalid JSON gives an error toast. Does not start computation.

name: Reset
explanation: Restore startup/test-window defaults and attempt catalog input selection. This changes the form, not already saved results.

name: Generic
explanation: Load generic library defaults: generic cannonball spacecraft and no test window. This differs from the Sentinel-3A startup preset.

name: Group headings / settings counts
explanation: Open or collapse a settings group. Counts report visible settings and modified values. Changing workflow/shape/force switches can reveal other fields.

name: Auto-select from catalog
explanation: Populate observations for one spacecraft and suitable product/reference/attitude/environment files for the cutoff. Adds matching files, not an accuracy guarantee.

name: Spacecraft selector
explanation: Select among spacecraft with observations for the current cutoff. Appears only if more than one spacecraft is available; reruns catalog suggestion, not orbit determination.

name: Latest from data
explanation: Set UTC cutoff to the end of the latest matching catalogued observation arc. It does not mean the current wall-clock time.
condition: UTC cutoff field in OD + Forecast

name: Run whole window
explanation: Start one new OD + forecast for each configured cutoff date. Uses the catalog separately per day; missing data remain visible. Confirmation states date count. This can take a long time.

name: Run
explanation: Start one new computation using the current workflow/settings. Disabled when validation errors exist or a job is active. For presenting existing results, use Saved presentation instead.

name: Sweep…
explanation: Vary one enum/bool/numeric setting while keeping other form settings fixed. Starting a sweep runs new computations; opening/cancelling its dialog does not.

name: Compare product tiers
explanation: Launch a four-tier sweep using Broadcast, Ultra-rapid, Rapid and Final. It explicitly changes the sweep copy to RECONSTRUCTION so later products can be compared. It does not certify forecast-safe accuracy.
condition: OD + Forecast with observations/products; otherwise explains missing prerequisites

name: Cancel
explanation: Requests cancellation of the currently tracked job. It is shown while active work is running; exact stop timing depends on cancellation checks. It is not a delete-results action.

name: Ready/errors/progress/log
explanation: Ready to run means configuration validation passed, not that accuracy targets will be met. Error list names blockers. Progress/log show stages, sweep/window case numbers and execution messages.

name: ⓘ / i
explanation: Shows what the setting means, how to choose it, its configuration key and startup default. Click elsewhere to dismiss. Workflow itself is represented by the top toggle rather than a normal field.

name: Changed marker / reset
explanation: Non-mandatory settings differing from startup defaults show changed and reset. Reset restores only that setting, then revalidates. Mandatory fields do not have this marker/reset behavior.

name: Checkbox
explanation: Toggle on/off; conditional dependent fields may appear or disappear. Exact impact is documented for each of the 85 settings.

name: Number field
explanation: Enter an integer or numeric value; browser min/max/step are shown in the field inventory. These UI bounds are not a complete statement of server-side scientific validation.

name: Date / datetime / text
explanation: Dates are calendar cutoff dates. Scientific epoch fields are interpreted as UTC despite using a datetime-local browser control; do not convert them to your local time zone.

name: Span presets
explanation: Set forecast.spanDays to 7, 14, 21 or 30 days immediately. They change the form, not an existing saved output.

name: Add from catalog…
explanation: Only lists catalog entries of the kinds allowed by that field. Options vary with the catalog and its file names. Select to add or replace the input. Multi-file values are deduplicated.

name: Browse…
explanation: Open the shared file picker. Multi-file inputs add paths; single-file inputs replace the selection.

name: Selected file ×
explanation: Remove the path from this configuration only. Does not delete or forget the file globally.

name: none selected / not set (default used)
explanation: Multi-file fields show none selected; a single optional field not set may use a built-in/default model. Check its specific documented behavior and run defaults list.

name: Setting to vary
explanation: Includes every enum, boolean, integer and number parameter except workflow, even if a field is conditional in the current form. The complete candidates are indexed in the parameter appendix. Avoid choices incompatible with the selected workflow.

name: Value checkboxes
explanation: For an enum, check the listed model choices; for a boolean, choose on and off. All are initially checked. At least two valid values are required.

name: Values, separated by commas
explanation: For numeric parameters, enter comma-separated values in the parameter units. Initially suggests half/current/1.5× values. Review integer/bounds constraints before starting.

name: Cancel / Start sweep
explanation: Cancel dismisses; Start sweep submits up to 12 sequential cases and eventually opens a comparison. Escape/backdrop also cancel.

name: Current value / explanation
explanation: Shows the selected parameter definition, current value and units. It does not modify the parameter until a sweep starts.

name: Run picker
explanation: Select a saved local History run. These are workspace runs, separate from the bundled Saved presentation archive. Opening a saved run does not recompute its OD or trajectory.

name: Download OEM
explanation: Download the selected run's stored OEM, when present. Failed runs may have no OEM.

name: Log
explanation: Open the saved execution log in a new tab. Use it to inspect defaults, progress and failure messages.

name: Re-use settings
explanation: Load this result's configuration into Run; does not execute it until Run is pressed.

name: KML
explanation: Export the selected trajectory for Google Earth. This derives an export from saved output, not a new orbit propagation.

name: CZML
explanation: Export the selected trajectory for Cesium from saved data.

name: Report
explanation: Open the printable run report in a new browser tab; use browser Print/Save PDF. Includes saved summaries, inputs, settings, figures and passes.

name: Earth-fixed / Inertial
explanation: Change the globe rendering frame; do not confuse a visualization toggle with the configured OEM output frame.

name: Spacecraft model
explanation: Automatic chooses a procedural drawing from object name; explicit models override the drawing only. It does not alter force-model geometry or physics.

name: Follow satellite
explanation: Camera follows the satellite. Drag to look around; scroll changes follow distance. Toggle off for globe-centred navigation.

name: Full view / Leave full view
explanation: Enlarge the globe to the application window. Use Leave full view or Escape to restore the layout.

name: Globe mouse gestures
explanation: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset the camera. In follow mode these act around the spacecraft.

name: Map layers
explanation: Toggle Full track, Reference, Day / night, Stations and Grid independently. Layer changes only affect drawing. Reference is POEORB display data, not a correction to prediction.

name: Map hover / click
explanation: Hover scrubs the shared time when playback is paused. Click selects that epoch and pauses playback; subsequent pointer movement can scrub again. It is not a persistent time-lock switch.

name: Play / Pause
explanation: Animate saved samples; wraps to the start at the end. Does not integrate a new orbit.

name: Playback speed
explanation: Choose simulated-time speed relative to wall time. It affects animation only.

name: Time slider
explanation: Scrub the saved sample sequence; UTC and elapsed-hours readouts update. Drawing may interpolate between samples, so use sufficiently dense trajectories for meaningful tracks.

name: 1σ ellipsoid
explanation: Show the formal position uncertainty ellipsoid when covariance exists. The visual scale multiplier is explicitly displayed. It is not measured error and excludes unmodelled effects.

name: Run summary and warnings
explanation: Status/mode/object/cutoff, state count, fit type/count/iterations, pre/post-fit RMS, variance factor, optional estimated Cd/Cr and uncertainties, product usage/rejection/fallbacks, defaults, warnings, errors, flags and runtime. Missing optional quantities are not invented.

name: Diagnostic plots
explanation: Altitude; RTN formal 1σ; 3D/R/T/N error against reference; satellite count/PDOP; accepted/rejected SPP residual RMS; OD residual norms. A plot appears only when its saved data exist.

name: GNSS positioning per epoch
explanation: Expand to inspect UTC, GPS product, satellite count, PDOP, RMS, accepted/rejected indicator and reason. Predicted orbit tags identify predicted GPS orbit nodes.

name: Stations
explanation: Expand the workspace-wide station editor. Changes affect pass calculations/display for runs in that workspace; they do not refit the orbit.

name: Station Name
explanation: Human-readable station label.

name: Latitude / Longitude
explanation: Geodetic degrees; latitude north-positive and longitude east-positive. Use valid terrestrial coordinates.

name: Height
explanation: Station ellipsoidal height in metres, not kilometres.

name: Elevation mask
explanation: Minimum elevation angle in degrees above the station horizon for a pass to count.

name: Station ×
explanation: Remove that station from the editor; use Save stations to persist the edited list.

name: Add station
explanation: Append a station with zero coordinates/height and 5-degree elevation mask. Edit it before saving.

name: Save stations
explanation: Validate and persist the station list, update globe/map markers and derive passes from saved trajectories. This does not run OD/propagation.

name: Pass row
explanation: AOS/LOS are acquisition/loss of signal times. The row shows duration and maximum elevation; click to jump to AOS. A truncated span is marked. Requires an adequate sampling cadence and station(s).

name: Window picker
explanation: Choose a locally saved window campaign; shows its name, date interval and completion count. The bundled two-month archive is in Saved presentation, not automatically this local list.

name: Refresh
explanation: Reload the existing local window list and selected record. Does not rerun it.

name: Delete record
explanation: Delete the window summary after confirmation. Its individual run records stay in History.

name: Progress and summary tiles
explanation: Cutoff count, processed, issued, unusable OD, no data, flagged cases and median post-fit RMS. No data is separate from fitting failure. Active campaigns show a progress bar and stage.

name: Trend charts
explanation: OD RMS and SPP fix count per date; errors vs POEORB appear where reference scores exist. Missing values are gaps, not zeros.

name: Per-day row / flags hover
explanation: Shows cutoff date, status, GPS product, fixes, RMS, variance factor, flags, cutoff/day-one/day-seven errors and runtime. Hover products/flags for details; click a row with a runId to open Results.

name: Run checkboxes
explanation: Select two or more locally saved runs for comparison. They do not select bundled snapshot cases.

name: Compare selected
explanation: Open comparison for the checked runs; at least two required. It compares saved trajectories rather than recomputing the physics.

name: Open
explanation: Open that saved run in Results.

name: Re-use
explanation: Load that run's settings in Run, without executing them.

name: Delete run
explanation: Delete the chosen saved run and its output files after confirmation. This differs from forgetting a raw input or deleting a window summary.

name: History columns
explanation: Run ID, name, workflow, status, mode, cutoff/epoch, object, sample count and post-fit RMS. Values come from saved result records.

name: Base run and color legend
explanation: First selected run is the base. Other runs are compared to it; base is not automatically the most accurate run.

name: Position difference table
explanation: Maximum, RMS and end-of-span 3D separation from the base, in metres. Run-to-run separation is not reference-truth error.

name: Settings that differ
explanation: Configuration keys and values that changed between compared runs. Identical settings get an explicit message.

name: Comparison charts
explanation: Reference error curves when stored reference results exist; 3D difference and RTN difference curves for compatible sampled trajectories. Interpolation is used for non-coincident epochs; sparse daily campaign points must not be treated as dense tracks.

name: Question / Search
explanation: Type a project question and click Search or press Enter. Retrieves local passages and shows a grounded answer when an answer provider returns one.

name: Provider status line
explanation: Shows indexed passage/document counts, knowledge folder and configured provider order/status. Default extractive provider uses no model; optional provider availability is configuration-dependent.

name: Guides
explanation: Load the corresponding bundled help page.

name: Interactive feature guide
explanation: Open the separate feature guide in a new tab, just like the global Guide link.

name: Answer / passage citations
explanation: Answer includes provider attribution; passage cards show source, title and excerpts. No-result message means try different terms; it is not a new model training step.

name: Section index links
explanation: Jump to walkthrough, defaults/results, offline/search and feature groups. Active section styling follows scrolling.

name: Walkthrough steps
explanation: Choose any of the ten walkthrough panels.

name: Previous / Next
explanation: Move between walkthrough steps; disabled at endpoints. Left/right keyboard arrows also navigate when not typing in a text field or viewing an enlarged screenshot.

name: Filter features
explanation: Enter one or more terms; each shown feature must contain every term. The counter shows remaining features and a no-results message appears when appropriate.

name: Screenshot zoom
explanation: Click a screenshot, or focus it and press Enter/Space, to enlarge it. Close with Close, Escape or the modal backdrop.

name: Feature cards and guide text
explanation: Explain existing features. Some historical claims in the built-in guide predate the current data archive; use the Saved presentation provenance and current report for campaign facts, rather than its old no-IGS wording.
